Buyer-side counterparties listed with shipment counts: '676 NHP LAVERTON ... 104 - 106 WILLIAM ANGLISS DRIVE LAVERTON NTH VIC MELBOURNE, 3026, VICTORIA, AUSTRALIA', '721 PRECISION ELECTRICALS CO LLC ... DUBAI - U.A.E', '181 EXCELLENCE PRICES COMPANY LTD ... AL KHOBAR 34621 ... SAUDI ARABIA', '234 PRECISION ELECTRICALS CO.LLC-BRANCH ... DAMMAM 32231 SAUDI ARABIA', '415 AUTOMATION SYNERGYS FZC ... Jebel Ali'. Source counter: page claims 12051 shipments / 117 partners; only 5 dated rows and 5 buyer aggregates were visible on the free view.
note: Export side is factually confirmed: dated customs rows with B/L numbers (1006396, 9949783) show outbound cargo from Indian ports (Piyala ICD INBFR6) to Houston USA under HS 85389000, plus recurring buyer relationships in Australia, UAE and Saudi Arabia — this is a genuine exporter, not a website claim. Declared HS 847190 does not match the observed codes (85389000 electrical goods/cable duct accessories, 90158020 sensors, 39269099 plastic lugs); per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — actual HS should be corrected to the observed 85389000 family and verdict treated as accepted_hs_corrected. Role: the same page also shows large inbound flows (suppliers UNISTRUT LTD, FLEXICON LIMITED, K.S TERMINALS INC.), so the company is best classified manufacturer_trader / importer-exporter rather than pure manufacturer. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, annual-report splits) could NOT be verified: DuckDuckGo search returned connection errors on both attempts, thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403, volza.com returned HTTP 403, and trinitytouch.com was behind a bot-verification interstitial. Domestic status therefore recorded as unknown, not as none_found — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not a finding. Revenue and export volume figures: null (not public on free views, not invented).
